dimensions.name: Configuration validation inversion
dimensions.review_prompt: The boolean guard in BuildAgent at go/internal/node/node.go:176 changed from XOR (!=) to equivalence (==). Original: error when exactly one of OPENAI_API_KEY/OPENAI_BASE_URL is empty (rejects partial pairs). New: error when both are empty or both are non-empty (allows only exactly one configured). Verify: set OPENAI_API_KEY only, set OPENAI_BASE_URL only, set neither, set both — confirm the accepted/rejected combinations match the new equivalence semantics. Check callers of BuildAgent for behavior shifts.

dimensions.name: Error path divergence for callers
dimensions.review_prompt: Callers of BuildAgent that previously handled the 'neither key configured' case (no error, fallback behavior) will now receive a hard error at boot. Conversely, callers that previously errored on exactly-one-configured will now succeed. Identify all callers of BuildAgent in the codebase, trace their error handling, and verify the semantic shift: run the node with (a) no OpenAI keys, (b) only OPENAI_API_KEY, (c) only OPENAI_BASE_URL, (d) both, and confirm the new equivalence logic produces the expected accept/reject pattern.
